## What changed

Describe the behavior and why it is needed.

## Validation

List exact commands, platforms, versions, and results. Include negative and recovery tests where relevant.

## Operational impact

Describe migrations, permissions, configuration, resource use, compatibility, privacy, rollback, and data-safety effects. Write `None` only after checking each area.

## Remaining validation

List anything that could not be tested. Do not describe an untested game, restore, installer, or security property as supported.

## Checklist

- [ ] I did not include credentials, private host data, personal data, or proprietary assets.
- [ ] I ran the relevant Rust and frontend checks.
- [ ] I tested likely failure paths and bounded new work.
- [ ] I updated documentation, status, tests, and changelog where needed.
- [ ] I verified current upstream versions and official sources for game or platform integration changes.
